context.statement: Exact replay of the six universal real scalar and finite-sum assertions of WeightedInverse in the immutable C_SWI_ALG version 2 source; this context is mathematics, not an assertion of review completeness or geometric applicability.

definitions.scalars: All numerical variables in the first five declarations are real. delta>0, B>=0 and energy>=0 are used as individually stated; root monotonicity and reciprocal bounds additionally assume a>=0 with the positive parameters stated in the source.
definitions.curvature_sum: For any decidable index type and finite set J, individual real lower bounds -c imply the finite sum lower bound -card(J)*c; no geometry is encoded.
definitions.source: Byte-identical replay of campaign 9000057 research/spectral_weighted_inverse/Main.lean, copied only into research/draft_reviews/scalar_certificate/replay. The exact original fidelity retains the old C_SWI_ALG name intentionally.
